_style: 3D animated children's storybook illustration in a warm Pixar-like style, soft sunlight, a Jewish neighbourhood in Israel with Jerusalem-stone houses. No domes, no churches, no mosques, no crosses, no religious buildings in the background. One clear, simple scene for a toddler picture book. No text, no letters, no numbers.

_characters.Ari: a 6-year-old boy with curly brown hair, a small navy knitted kippah, light blue sweater, navy trousers, white sneakers
_characters.Tamar: a 7-year-old girl with long brown hair in two braids, pink long-sleeved top, navy knee-length skirt, white tights, navy shoes
_characters.Ima: a young mother with a sage-green head scarf tied at the back and a lavender long-sleeved midi dress
_characters.Eli: a smiling baby boy with light brown hair in a pale yellow onesie
